note: Built-in presets are defined in stages/presets.py and listed here for reference; everything under "presets" with builtin: false was saved from a run.

builtin.name: Talking head
builtin.description: Fast: the face mesh drawn on the original video, no depth or SAM calls (free preparation).

builtin.name: Full body
builtin.description: Advanced: Depth Anything plus a SAM 3 cutout of the subject; full mask review.

builtin.name: Expressive
builtin.description: Advanced + Face mesh: the depth cutout with facial motion drawn on top; gaps only warn.

builtin.name: Profile-heavy
builtin.description: Advanced with the face mesh off: best when the speaker turns away from the camera a lot.
